subject: SemPlot - coefficients superimposed in graphing the solution

messages.author: 2b61abd441ae942a
messages.subject: SemPlot - coefficients superimposed in graphing the solution
parts:
I was wondering if someone encountered the problem before. It is technically SemPlot library, not lavaan. I am trying to plot the solution to a multivariate regression, and the coefficients on some paths coming from multiple variables to the same outcome variable are layered one on top of the other. I am attaching a picture to demonstrate it with highlighted laid over coefficients in yellow. I know I could save the image as a metafile and move the superimposed coefficients away from where they overalap, but there should be an easier solution to it.

I am using the following simple code:

library("semPlot")
semPaths(fit.model.age.gender.test, what = "std", edge.label.cex = 0.9,
layout = "tree", residuals = FALSE, edge.color = 1,
esize = 1, rotation = 3, sizeMan = 8, asize = 2.5,
fade = FALSE, optimizeLatRes = TRUE)
